completion:
INT. DRAFTING ROOM — NIGHT

A single overhead lamp pools on a bare table. The walls fall away into black. A hand enters frame, places a folded radio script beside an empty teacup, and withdraws.

Camera tracks slowly toward the cup. Steam rises once, then dies. On the cut, the lamp flickers as if the building itself inhaled.
